[Post to liven things up here] What are your thoughts on the current state of the story?
With that last chapter very good, especially with all the talk on Yonko. I'm definitely ready for the next arc, we finally get to see how well Sanji and the others have fared against Big Mom's ship.

I think it's really good right now. The past two chapters I got a little bit of arc fatigue because it just felt like it should be over, but with this chapter, Oda set up so much stuff and gave so many hints of information that it's back to really good. Also, I should note that two slow chapters isn't enough for me to say One Piece is in a bad state, it's just the arc fatigue, and Dressrosa is a fantastic arc.

I've been craving for the arc epilogue for a long time, that and the buildup is the reason I read One Piece. I like the fights, but I like this better... to see how their actions affect the world, to see people's reaction to the crazy shit they do is amazing.

I'm pretty excited with the current state of things.

Each arc feels like it's building into something bigger than the previous one at the moment, and it feels like were actually at a point in the story where pivotal things are starting to happen. Not drawing to a close yet, but I reckon we're probably around 2/3rds of the way through the overall storyline now (though its obviously kind of impossible to know for real...).

But yea, pretty excited! Lots of big things coming up.

I thought that every thing that happened in the Dressrosa arc was pretty interesting, but like others say, I am exhausted by it and ready for more plot development. WHAT IS THE WILL OF D!? It's been like 20 years!!! ANSWER US, ODA!
